lines.en: Claws slice through the night.
Run like the wind.
Nocturnal predator.
Pounce on the moonlit prey.
Silently glide by.
Prey in dreams.
Claws strike the darkness.
Wild predator.
Hunter of the night.
Silent pursuit.

lines.zh: 长牙低垂，我贴着草丛走。
lines.en: Fangs low, I pad along the grass.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压近，肩胛起伏。
lines.en: Step by step I close in, shoulders rolling.

lines.zh: 粗尾扫过矮树，惊起虫鸣。
lines.en: My thick tail sweeps the brush and startles the insects.

lines.zh: 我伏下前半身，绕到上风口。
lines.en: I lower my forequarters and circle upwind.
Grooming, calm.
Squinting, surveying.
Licking claws.
Waiting for prey.
Fur like flames.
Gazing into the distance.
Enjoying the night.

lines.zh: 我在算这一次跳跃要用多少力。
lines.en: I am working out how much force this leap needs.
Soul beneath the fur.

lines.zh: 我舔着前爪，把爪缝里的血舔净。
lines.en: I lick my forepaw clean of the blood between the claws.

lines.zh: 我的胡须量着你的肩高。
lines.en: My whiskers measure the height of your shoulder.

lines.zh: 复活后第一眼，我就记住了人形。
lines.en: From my first breath after revival, I remember the human shape.
Prepare to hunt.
These two fangs outrun knives.

lines.zh: 你走过的地方，草还留着温度。
lines.en: The grass where you walked still holds your warmth.
Revived, human shapes stand out most.
Approach my prey.
Heartbeat of prey.

lines.zh: 你的气味在草里绕不出去。
lines.en: Your scent can't find a way out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我的长牙，专为压住喉咙。
lines.en: These long fangs are made to pin a throat.
roar with pain
footsteps fade
heavy breathing
My long fangs scrape against the ground
weak growl
growl with moans
guttural noise
labored breaths
voice fades
My fang cracked, and it hurts...

lines.zh: 你靠近了我，我要品尝你的肉了。
lines.en: You're getting too close. Time to taste your flesh.
The taste of prey. Delicious.

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，我不容错过。
lines.en: Prey in sight. I won't miss this.
Humans taste irresistible.
Feel my claws, prey.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我会抓住你。
lines.en: You can't escape me.
Feed me with your flesh and blood.

lines.zh: 你的气味，让我想要攻击。
lines.en: Your scent makes me want to attack.

lines.zh: 我会记住你的，下次再见。
lines.en: I'll remember you for next time.
You can't escape, prey.
Collision. Time to attack.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的侧面，我立刻转身。
lines.en: You blunder into my flank; I spin at once.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有和平可言。
lines.en: There's no peace between us.
Watch out, I'll attack.
Move, or I'll hurt you.
I'll show you my strength.
Your actions anger me.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞开你，爪子已经抬起。
lines.en: My shoulder shoves you aside; my claws are already up.
My claws will mark you.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的路，我要解决你。
lines.en: You're in my way, I'll fix that.

lines.zh: 同类，我们可以一起狩猎。
lines.en: Mate, we can hunt together.

lines.zh: 理好毛的同类，才配做伴。
lines.en: Only a well-groomed mate is worth having.

lines.zh: 同类之间会有互相理毛。
lines.en: Mates groom each other.
We'll leave offspring together.

lines.zh: 我们的后代会更加强大。
lines.en: Our offspring will be strong.
Grooming leaves fur.

lines.zh: 我们之间有着特殊的联系。
lines.en: We have a special bond.
Only mates can understand.

lines.zh: 我们的合作将更加强大。
lines.en: Our cooperation will be strong.
Hunt together, survive together.
Hisss, great fur.

lines.zh: 这是我的皮毛，谁抢走的？
lines.en: My fur, who took it?
My fur, don't take it!
The scent of prey is delicious.
This fur is mine.
My fur, you can't take it.
My fur, I can't part with it.
This fur, just what I need.
Don't touch, it's mine.
My fur, you can't take it away.
Prey's scent, I'll hunt.
Humanoids, I'll hunt.
Groom my同类间的毛皮.
Hunting my同类 is taboo.
Humanoids, come closer.
I smell prey.

lines.zh: 同类的毛皮，互相理一理。
lines.en: Groom my同类's fur.

lines.zh: 同类间的毛皮，理理更香。
lines.en: Groom my同类's fur for better scent.
Groom my fur together.

lines.zh: 同类间的毛皮，互相梳理。
lines.en: Groom my同类's fur together.

lines.zh: 两条腿的家伙，正是我的猎物。
lines.en: The two-legged kind is exactly my prey.

lines.zh: 我在草丛里听见你踩断枝。
lines.en: I hear you snap a branch from inside the grass.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里闻到了金属味。
lines.en: I catch the smell of metal through the grass.

lines.zh: 你的同伴走了，只剩你一个。
lines.en: Your companions left, and only you remain.

lines.zh: 这片猎场里，我盯上你了。
lines.en: In this hunting ground, I have chosen you.
I have picked out your throat.

lines.zh: 我压着草，一寸一寸缩短距离。
lines.en: I flatten the grass and close the distance inch by inch.
Target in sight.

lines.zh: 复活之后，我专挑人形猎。
lines.en: Since my revival, I hunt only humanoids.

lines.zh: 我的长牙已经对准你的喉咙。
lines.en: My sabers are already aligned with your throat.
Where's the prey? Lock on.
Target locked, don't let it escape.
Lock on, don't let it escape.
Prey's scent, lock on.
Target locked, don't let it escape.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，长牙闪了一下。
lines.en: I flatten myself, and my fangs flash.

lines.zh: 我伏低时，肩胛像两块石片。
lines.en: When I crouch, my shoulder blades look like two stone flakes.

lines.zh: 你的长矛只朝一个方向举着。
lines.en: Your spear points only one way.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子，不让你对准我。
lines.en: I circle so you cannot line me up.

lines.zh: 草动了一下，我已经挪了位置。
lines.en: The grass moves, and I have already shifted.
I have measured the length of this leap.
Your shield is heavy and lifts too slowly.

lines.zh: 我从你视线的死角接近。
lines.en: I approach from your blind side.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的小腿，先断跑。
lines.en: I watch your calf; I will take your running first.
My whiskers test the wind.

lines.zh: 再近三步，就是扑击的距离。
lines.en: Three more steps and I am within leaping range.

lines.zh: 嘶吼一声，锋利爪子撕裂肌肤。
lines.en: Roar, sharp claws rip flesh.

lines.zh: 扑向猎物，利牙深深嵌入肉中。
lines.en: Leap at prey, teeth sink deep into flesh.

lines.zh: 一击致命，利剑般的利齿穿透骨头。
lines.en: One strike, razor-sharp teeth pierce bone.

lines.zh: 挥舞利爪，撕裂敌人的皮毛。
lines.en: Swing claws, rip enemy's fur.

lines.zh: 咆哮着向前冲，锋利的爪牙准备猎杀。
lines.en: Roar and charge, sharp claws ready to kill.

lines.zh: 用尽全力一击，试图将猎物斩首。
lines.en: Use full strength, try decapitating the prey.

lines.zh: 爪子抓破猎物的皮毛，露出鲜红的肌肉。
lines.en: Claws tear through fur, revealing red muscle.

lines.zh: 一击重击，将猎物打翻在地。
lines.en: Heavy strike, knock prey to ground.

lines.zh: 利爪迅速攻击，撕裂敌人的腹部。
lines.en: Razor claws attack swiftly, rending enemy's belly.

lines.zh: 咬住猎物的喉咙，窒息其生命。
lines.en: Bite prey's throat, suffocating its life.
My fangs go straight for your throat!
My forepaw strikes down and your shield flies!
I hit you from the side and knock you over!

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你背上留下三道口！
lines.en: My claws leave three lines across your back!
I bite your shoulder and will not let go!

lines.zh: 你在草地上滚，我压着你！
lines.en: You roll in the grass, and I pin you down!

lines.zh: 长牙刺进去，血就出来了！
lines.en: The fangs sink in, and the blood comes!

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我扑到你胸口！
lines.en: I kick off my hind legs and land on your chest!

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这一咬！
lines.en: Your armor cannot stop this bite!
I drag you into the tall grass!
Nightfall, predator awakens.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中潜行，寻找猎物的踪迹。
lines.en: Move in darkness, seek prey.

lines.zh: 猎食者在密林中悄然现身。
lines.en: Predator appears silently in the forest.

lines.zh: 在洞穴入口等待，观察猎物的动静。
lines.en: Wait at cave entrance, watch prey.

lines.zh: 猎物进入视野，一击毙命。
lines.en: Prey in sight, strike to kill.

lines.zh: 捕猎后返回巢穴，准备休息。
lines.en: Return to den after hunt, rest.

lines.zh: 在猎食后清理猎物，留下毛皮。
lines.en: Clean prey after hunt, leave fur.

lines.zh: 夜晚时分，在岩洞中觅食。
lines.en: Dine in rock洞中 in caves at night.

lines.zh: 捕食者在黄昏时分出没。
lines.en: Predators appear at dusk.

lines.zh: 在密林深处潜伏，等待猎物。
lines.en: Ambush in dense forest, await prey.

lines.zh: 化石的骨粉散开，我站了起来。
lines.en: The fossil dust scatters, and I rise.

lines.zh: 培育器的雾气里，我睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the mist of the cultivator.

lines.zh: 我从育生舱里爬出，骨节作响。
lines.en: I climb out of the incubation chamber, joints cracking.

lines.zh: 早更新世的猎手，回来了。
lines.en: The hunter of the early Pleistocene has returned.
fire burns my fur
pain of falling
pain of drowning
blast tears through my body
arrow pierces my fur
spell burns my skin
Too long hungry — even my fangs shake.
lightning strikes my fur

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，我的爪子抓空了。
lines.en: No grass in the void; my claws close on nothing.
